川湖科技 2059 客戶 第二供應商 自製 滑軌 2026

findings.claim: Daiwa Securities 預期 King Slide 供應 Nvidia 系統滑軌套件的份額明年可能降至約 75%，因 Nvidia 擴大供應商基礎；新製造商通過認證後，資料中心營運商亦可用競爭壓價。
findings.source: Forklog, Taiwan's richest person emerges from AI demand surge (citing Daiwa Securities)
findings.excerpt: the company's share in supplying slide kits for Nvidia systems may decrease to about 75% next year as the chipmaker expands its supplier base.

findings.claim: Taipei Times 報導川湖客戶含 Nvidia 與大型 CSP，AI 伺服器滑軌套件全球市占 70–80%。
findings.excerpt: The company counts Nvidia Corp and major cloud service providers (CSPs) among its major clients, commanding 70 to 80 percent of global market share in AI server rail kits.

note: 未找到客戶自製（in-house）滑軌的來源；未找到具名第二供應商協議。
